c.description:
Available January 16, 2027

Fully furnished, luxurious 2 bedroom apartment suite for rent in Kitsilano.

- 2 bedrooms
- 1 bathroom
- 1,050 square feet

Kitsilano Penthouse Suite. This 2 bedroom (with queen beds) and 1 full bath is the jewel of the Manor. Located on the top floor, it offers north, south and east views. Lots of light. Private south-facing balcony. Skylights. Open layout with combined kitchen/living/dining areas.

One of seven private apartments in a restored Heritage Home. Unique furnishings. The location - steps to shops, cafes, public transportation and public beaches - is perfect for both vacation travelers or professionals coming to UBC and/or downtown.

Furnished Suite Rental Features:

- Shared laundry in the building (coin-operated)
- Ultra high speed fibre optic Wireless internet
- Flat screen TV (46 ")
- Local phone
- Built in microwave
- Dishwasher
- Fireplace
- South facing balcony
- Skylights
- View of ocean and mountains
- Free street parking and $100 private parking

Price per month: $4,595
Cleaning Fee: $495

Sorry, no pets.

Please quote reference #445 when inquiring about the property.
